name: Century West
label: Century West
about_prose: Century West is a City of Bend neighborhood district on the southwest edge of town, centered on the SW Century Drive corridor about 2.5 miles from central Bend. The city recognized it as a formal district on July 20, 2005. The boundary runs between the Deschutes River corridor to the north and the Deschutes National Forest to the west, and most of the housing inside it is single-family, built after 2000. That makes Century West one of the newer subdivisions on Bend's west side, not one of the older neighborhoods closer to downtown.

The defining fact of the address is the road. SW Century Drive runs through the district and becomes the Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway, Forest Route 46, at the edge of town, a 66-mile national scenic byway that climbs past Todd Lake, Sparks Lake, Devils Lake, and Elk Lake before ending at Highway 58 southeast of Oakridge. Mt. Bachelor sits about 22 miles and a 22-minute drive west of the neighborhood. The byway closes each winter beyond Mt. Bachelor, so for months of the year the route from here is a drive to one mountain, not a through-road across the Cascades.

Farewell Bend Park anchors the neighborhood's river access, at 1000 SW Reed Market Road on the Deschutes. Bend Park and Recreation District acquired the 22-acre site in 1990. Its playground carries a lumber-mill theme, a nod to the industry that built Bend, and the park also has a climbing and bouldering area, a small beach, a boat launch, and a trailhead for the Deschutes River Trail. From there, the paved Haul Road Trail runs west, parallel to Century Drive and then the Cascade Lakes Highway, out to the Deschutes National Forest boundary. The park district finished a three-mile upgrade to that trail in 2021, funded largely through a federal Lands Access Program grant.

Families are assigned to William E. Miller Elementary, ranked in the top 5% of Oregon elementary schools, and Cascade Middle School, ranked in the top 10% of Oregon middle schools, with Summit High School at the high school level. Bend-La Pine Schools' most recent boundary review kept the Century Drive corridor, along with Tetherow and Broken Top, on the Summit attendance area while other district boundaries shifted. OSU-Cascades, the only four-year university in Central Oregon, opened its main campus at 1500 SW Chandler Avenue in 2016 just north of the district, with a smaller annex at 497 SW Century Drive inside it. A university annex, a middle school, and a national forest boundary sitting within blocks of each other is not a common mix for a Bend neighborhood.

The trade-off is the same road that makes the location. Century Drive is Mt. Bachelor's only route in and out, and Bend officials have pointed to two things that back it up most mornings and afternoons: Cascade Middle School's drop-off and pickup schedule, and ski traffic, typically for 10 to 15 minutes at a stretch, longer on powder days and holiday weekends. Retail inside the district is limited to a Safeway-anchored center at Century Drive and Simpson Avenue. For a wider choice of restaurants and shops, the drive into the Old Mill District or downtown Bend runs 5 to 10 minutes, short, but still a drive rather than a walk.

amenities.description: A 22-acre Bend Park and Recreation park at 1000 SW Reed Market Road along the Deschutes, with a lumber-mill-themed playground, climbing wall, covered picnic areas, and a Deschutes River Trail trailhead.

amenities.description: A Bend-La Pine Schools grades 6-8 campus at 19619 Mountaineer Way, ranked in the top 10% of Oregon middle schools.

amenities.name: William E. Miller Elementary
amenities.description: A Bend-La Pine Schools K-5 at 300 NW Crosby Dr, ranked in the top 5% of Oregon elementary schools.

amenities.name: OSU-Cascades
amenities.description: Oregon State University's branch campus, the only four-year university in Central Oregon, with a main campus at 1500 SW Chandler Ave (opened 2016) and a Century Drive annex at 497 SW Century Drive.

amenities.name: Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway Access
amenities.description: SW Century Drive becomes the Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway at the western edge, with direct access to the Deschutes National Forest and Mt. Bachelor.
